'''Ayx''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who grew up on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While Ayx was a [[Youngling/Legends|child]], his [[Javul Charn's mother|mother]] and [[Javul Charn's father|father]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Empire and he and his sister [[Javul Charn|Alai Jance]] were subsequently sent to live with the family of a [[Kendara Farlion's father|friend]] of their father, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Ayx later enlisted into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and became a member of a Rebel cell that was active on the world [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
